uncertainty_caution: Table 3 labels parentheses as std without enough detail to interpret them as seed SD, SEM, or a CI. Do not use them as a replication acceptance band.
missing_inputs: Original CSI300 400-factor HDF5 panel for the paper's splits, with aligned stock IDs and timestamps
Observed forward returns and exact label endpoint conventions, including end-of-day handling
Original universe membership and normalization, clipping and missing-data processing
Selected learning rate, dropout, batch size, head specification, epochs, stopping rule, seeds and validation search grid
Portfolio leg weights, execution and rebalance timing, turnover definition, IR benchmark, aggregation and annualization

sample_count_ambiguity.resolution: Use the original timestamp manifest to establish actual coverage; do not silently drop a day or invent missing bars.

scope_boundary: Existing 27 daily CSI fits and six monthly CZ202 fits are adaptations. They are not results for this experiment. No synthetic factors, repeated daily bars, or padded substitute features may be represented as the original data.
